records.qtitle: Ban on Indian students in Australia
records.name: Jayant Chaudhary
records.qn_text:
(a) whether it is a fact that many students from the State of Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Punjab, Gujarat and UT of Jammu & Kashmir are likely to be barred for study in Australia, if so, the details thereof; and 
(b) whether Indian Government is taking up this issue with the Australian Government for resolution, if so, the details thereof including progress, as on date?

records.qtitle: Representation of Minorities in the corporate sector
records.name: Jayant Chaudhary
records.qn_text:
(a) whether Government collates data on minority representation in different industries through its diversity report, if so salient  features  of the report; and
(b) whether the minorities are underrepresented in the Indian Corporate sector and particularly at higher levels in the management of the companies and if so, what affirmative action the Ministry is mandating to correct this?

J

records.name: Jayant Chaudhary

records.qtitle: Health infrastructure facility in western Uttar Pradesh
records.name: Jayant Chaudhary
records.qn_text:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to poor health infrastructure in adjoining States, a lot of people are forced to visit AIIMS hospital from western Uttar Pradesh (UP)and NCR for treatment and spend on transportation; and
(b) whether Government has received any proposals from the State to establish medical care institutions like AIIMS in western UP and NCR  to cater to the region with its high population density, if so, the details of action taken so far?

records.name: Jayant Chaudhary

records.qtitle: Outlay and expenditure on PLI scheme
records.name: Jayant Chaudhary
Jayant Chaudhary
records.qn_text:
(a) whether Government had allowed the domestic industries, companies, organizations and individuals to trade in carbon credits and in particular also to sell carbon credits in international markets, if so, the details thereof; and
(b) whether selling of carbon credit to foreign market will impact Indian commitment towards Nationally Determined Contributions (NDC),  as agreed in the Paris Climate Change Meet of 2015?

records.subject: Protection of ancient cultures
records.extent:
Hon'ble Minister inter-alia stated as under:-
Respected Chairman, I don't have specific information about it right now, but all the things that have come out of Sinauli have been kept at the Indian Institute of Heritage which is being built in Greater Noida and work is going on. I do not have the specific information about its exact status, I will definitely provide it to you later. This venue is one of our newest finds. This place is one of the five new places found. Documentation and research has started on this some time ago.
(Original in hindi)
